title: Abba Yosef the Builder
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman describes him as a prominent figure in R’ Meir’s time. At the beginning of Shemot Rabbah, chapter 13 [supplied כש״ר רפ״יג], Avnimos HaGardi asks the sages how God created His world. Hyman says it was known that Avnimos was one of the gentile sages in R’ Meir’s time. The sages send him to Abba Yosef the Builder, who answers his question.

notes.text: The source siglum כש״ר has not been securely identified; the associated locator is the beginning of chapter13.

The saved whole TE ShemotRabbah13:1 scalar has Avnimos HaGardi sent to Abba Yosef the Builder about how the earth was created. It supports כש״ר as as-in ShemotRabbah and beginning of chapter13; Hyman’s world paraphrase is retained. His known-to-be-in-Meir’s-time chronology and gentile-sage identification remain his assertions, not facts established by this scalar. The earlier unidentified-siglum note is superseded specifically for this matching story, without a new historical identity binding.

Shemot Rabbah 13:1 has Avnimos ask how the earth was first created. The sages send him to Abba Yosef, who answers while at work as a day laborer. This identifies the story behind Hyman’s abbreviation and his paraphrase about the creation of the world. The passage gives neither the dating to R’ Meir’s time nor the description of Avnimos as a gentile sage.
